nits: js/events-data.js:22 — the 'Mystery Book Club: The Long Quiet' description reads 'This month we read Salt and Static companions…', which is garbled, and Salt and Static is listed as Science Fiction in js/books-data.js, not Mystery.

tests/run.mjs:21 falls back to a machine-specific path, /opt/node-tools/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs, while the README only says Playwright is 'resolved from the environment'; document PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE in the README or drop the hard-coded path.
js/books.js: the popstate listener never fires, because the filter only uses history.replaceState and never adds history entries; it can be removed.

styles.css .skip-link: when focused it sits on top of the dark header and the brand link, and its focus outline (var(--focus), #1f1a17) is about 1.09:1 against the header (#2b2118). The link text is still readable, but the outline can't be seen there.
js/visit.js: the 2000-character limit uses value.length, which counts UTF-16 code units, so each emoji counts as two characters toward the stated limit.
